title: Complete experiment design
purpose: Complete missing qualitative Design domains for one selected experiment using source evidence first, compatible Cabinet context second, targeted Knowledge Base references third, and cautious model inference only when useful. A deterministic Design Reference Resolver independently preserves Cabinet/KB candidates so small-model omissions or prompt compaction cannot silently erase usable reference-backed suggestions.
strategy: One selected experiment per run. LabFlow deterministically defines missing domains and resolves compact per-domain reference candidates independently of the model prompt. The same Design Reference Resolver feeds both model context and post-model semantic fallback, preventing context compaction from removing Cabinet/Knowledge Base candidates at validation time. The model may synthesize a richer proposal, but omitted or unresolved domains are filled from compatible Cabinet resources first and structured KB design hints second when available; only genuinely unsupported domains become auditable known unknowns. Researcher/source values are never overwritten automatically.
